description: Ingest a Detect & Refine behavioral beacon. Validates account_id (when provided), checks origin allowlist, consumes monthly quota, finds-or-creates the click row by (click_id, click_id_type), and upserts the session row by uuid. Returns 'tracked' on success or a descriptive error. session_id MUST be a uuid (the embed uses crypto.randomUUID()).

account_id.description: Tenant account id (acct_<hex>). Required when origin enforcement is on.

dnt.description: Do-Not-Track. When true, ip + visitor_id are not persisted.

ip_address.description: Forwarded IP. Stored only when dnt is false.

metrics.description: All behavioral signals — same shape as the embed beacon.

origin.description: Window.location.origin from the embed — checked against allowed_origins

page_url.description: URL of the landing page the visitor is on

session_id.description: Client-generated uuid (v4). Same id for every heartbeat in the visit.

name: dr_track
